jobs.occupation: Lärare åk 4-7 svenska och svenska som andraspråk
jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Behörig lärare i  svenska och svenska som andraspråk  sökes till åk 4-7

Vill du jobba i en internationell miljö med tydlig pedagogisk vision? 

Internationella engelska skolan har gjort stor skillnad för våra elever i 30 år. Vi är övertygade om att det är tack vare vårt tydliga etos med engagerade och närvarande ledare som våra skolor har en miljö där alla arbetar mot gemensamma mål. Vi har en stark kultur som bygger på beprövade rutiner. Hos oss får lärare fokus på undervisning och lärande. Eleverna står i centrum för allt vi gör, alla elever är dina elever.

På Internationella engelska skolan är vi ett team som drar åt samma håll. För att tycka om att jobba hos oss bör du dela vår övertygelse om vikten av tydliga värderingar, kollegialt lärande och gemensamma rutiner och förhållningssätt.   

IES är stolta över sina medarbetare och har tagit fram en metod för att skapa en lugn och trygg skolmiljö. Detta gör att våra lärare får mer tid till att dela sin kunskap, både med elever och kollegor. Din egen undervisning sker på svenska men kollegor emellan talar vi engelska/svenska. 

Vi söker nu en behörig lärare i svenska och svenska som andraspråk med svensk lärarlegitimation.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med tillträde HT 2026. Provanställning tillämpas de första 6 månaderna. 

Tjänstebeskrivning

Vi söker som vill vara med och göra skillnad för eleverna i deras livslånga lärande. Vår verksamhet genomsyras av ett positivt synsätt och vi har en stark tilltro till elevernas förmåga. En stark värdegrund och positiv elevsyn är mycket viktig för oss. Tillsammans med dina kollegor arbetar du för att skapa en trygghet, strukturerad, utvecklande och stimulerande lärmiljö för eleverna. Du arbetar tillsammans i team med lärarkollegor, stödpedagoger. Vårt uppdrag är att tillsammans leda och stötta eleverna i deras sociala och kunskapsmässiga utveckling. I teamet hjälps pedagogerna åt med planering, undervisning och elevernas skoldag.  Mentorskap för en klass kan ingå i tjänsten.

Vem är du?

Du har svensk lärarexamen med behörighet i svenska och svenska som andraspråk samt svensk lärarlegitimation för åk 4-7. Du har en klar pedagogisk insikt och förmåga att sätta läroplanens mål i ditt arbete. Du har ett tydligt ledarskap och står starkt i dina elevgrupper. Du är flexibel, strukturerad och väl förberedd. Du är en närvarande och medforskande pedagog som utmanar och stimulerar eleverna till utveckling. En stark tro på samarbete som en framgångsfaktor för den pedagogiska utvecklingen, är en självklarhet för dig. Du har en rak och ödmjuk kommunikation med vårdnadshavare och skapar tillitsfulla relationer till elever, vårdnadshavare samt kollegor. 

Du bör vara positiv och samarbetsvillig och beredd på att ingå i ett internationellt team.  

I din roll undervisar du på svenska, men kollegor emellan talar vi engelska i huvudsak men även svenska. Det gör att du behöver behärska båda språken flytande, både i tal och skrift. 

För mer information om vår skola, vänligen se https://engelska.se/our-schools/linkoping/

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan vilken du sänder till recruitment.linkoping@engelska.se Glöm inte att bifoga både CV och personligt brev. Märk ansökan med ”Sv+ma 4-7 ”.

Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden gått ut, så skickas i din ansökan redan idag. Utdrag ur belastningsregistret och id krävs.

About IES

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

jobs.employer_name: Ryd Naglar AB
jobs.description:
Denna annons även publicerad på engelska för att nå en bredare grupp av sökanden. Annonstexten på engelska finns längre ned i annonsen.
This advertisement has also been published in english to reach a wider pool of applicants. The english version of the text can be found further down in the advertisement.

Svenska / Swedish
Är du en erfaren nagelteknolog som är ute efter nya utmaningar? Eller är du en nyutbildad nagelteknolog som söker en stabil arbetsplats för att vidareutveckla dina färdigheter? Då tycker vi att du ska läsa vidare denna jobbannons!
Vilka är vi?
Vi på Ryd Naglar AB har bedrivit vår verksamhet i nagelsalongen Euro Nails i Mjölby sedan ett par år tillbaka! Vi är en väletablerad aktör inom branschen i Mjölby. För att stärka vårt team söker vi nu därför ytterligare en nagelteknolog till vår verksamhet.
Vem är du?
Vi ser fram emot att du som söker ska ha följande egenskaper och kvalifikationer:
Utbildad nagelteknolog
Kunna tala minst 1 av följande språk; antingen svenska, och/eller vietnamesiska och/eller engelska
Är flexibel med arbetstider då obekväma arbetstider kan förekomma
Kunna arbeta med både akryl och gelé

Vidare ser vi det som mycket meriterande om något av nedanstående passar in på dig:
Du talar minst 2 språk
Längre branscherfarenhet är ett stort plus
Har erfarenhet från en internationell arbetsmiljö, då specifikt inom skönhetsbranschen. Det kan vara tidigare anställningar från annat land i Europa, Dubai, Japan eller USA.

Vad vi kan erbjuda för dig?
Som nahelteknolog hos oss tillhör du ett team av erfarna nagelteknologer. Vidare erhåller du en chans att utvecklas till en kompetent yrkesutövare.
Som anställd på Ryd Naglar AB erhåller du en trygg anställning i ett företag som tillämpar kollektivavtal (Skönhetsvårdsavtalet) som finns tecknat mellan arbetsgivaren och Handelsanställdas Förbund.
Denna tjänst avser en tillsvidareanställning på heltid, med start snarast möjligt! Om sökanden finns utanför Sverige och behöver arbetstillstånd för att kunna arbeta i Sverige kan företaget Ryd Naglar AB bistå med hjälp i ärendet. Kravet då är att arbetstagaren måste befinna sig i Sverige, samt gå till jobbet max 2 månader efter beviljad ansökan om arbetstillstånd av Migrationsverket.
- - - -
Låter det fortsatt intressant? Då tycker vi att du snarast skickar in din ansökan. Ansökan skickas in på epost, mejladressen är: rydnaglarab@gmail.com
Vi ser fram emot att få välkomna dig in i laget!

__________________________

Engelska / English
Are you an experienced nail technician looking for new challenges? Or are you a newly qualified nail technician seeking a stable workplace to further develop your skills? If so, we encourage you to read on!
Who are we?
At Ryd Naglar AB, we have been operating the Euro Nails salon in Mjölby for several years. We are a well-established player in the local industry. To strengthen our team, we are now looking for an additional nail technician.
Who are you?
We are looking for a candidate with the following qualities and qualifications:
Qualified nail technician
Ability to speak at least one of the following languages: Swedish, Vietnamese, and/or English
Flexibility regarding working hours, as shifts outside standard hours may occur
Proficiency in working with both acrylic and gel

We consider it a significant advantage if any of the following apply to you:
You speak at least two languages
Extensive industry experience is a major plus
Experience in an international work environment, specifically within the beauty industry (e.g., previous employment in other European countries, Dubai, Japan, or the USA)

What do we offer?
As a nail technician with us, you will join a team of experienced professionals and have the opportunity to develop into a highly skilled practitioner.
As an employee of Ryd Naglar AB, you will have secure employment with a company that adheres to the collective agreement (So called: Skönhetsvårdsavtalet) signed between the employer and the Swedish Commercial Employees' Union (Handelsanställdas Förbund).
This is a full-time, permanent position with a start date as soon as possible! If the applicant is currently outside Sweden and requires a work permit to work in the country, Ryd Naglar AB can assist with the process. Please note that the employee must be present in Sweden and start work no later than two months after the Swedish Migration Agency has granted the work permit.
- - - -
Does this sound interesting? If so, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. Please send your application via email to: rydnaglarab@gmail.com
We look forward to welcoming you to the team!

jobs.occupation: Work in Sweden 2027  Great Pay, Affordable Housing & Career Opportunities
jobs.employer_name: Svedberga Plantskola AB
jobs.description:
Work in Sweden 2027 – Great Pay, Affordable Housing & Career Opportunities
Svedberga Plantskola AB is hiring 2–3 experienced and hardworking employees for the 2027 planting seasons in Sweden.
We welcome applicants from all countries, particularly Poland and Romania.
Svedberga is an established Swedish company specialising in the sale, delivery and planting of hedges, trees and other plants throughout Sweden.
We are looking for reliable, motivated and physically fit individuals who enjoy outdoor work, take responsibility and can maintain a consistently high working pace.
Employment Periods – 2027
Spring season: 15 March – 30 June 2027

Autumn season: 15 August – 31 October 2027

IMPORTANT: You MUST be available to work during BOTH periods. Applications from candidates who are only available for one season will NOT be considered.
For the right candidates, there is also an opportunity for continued employment and year-round work.
Work Location and Working Hours
Work is mainly carried out in southern Sweden at various customer locations.

Full-time employment during both seasonal periods.

Opportunities for overtime when required.

Travel and occasional overnight stays away from the main work location are part of the job.

Main Responsibilities
Planting hedges, trees and larger plants

Digging, ground preparation and landscaping work

Loading, unloading and handling plants

Practical work in nurseries and landscaping projects

Other duties related to the company's operations

Who Are We Looking For?
We are looking for candidates with previous experience in physically demanding work, such as forestry planting, agriculture, nurseries, groundworks or landscaping.
Mandatory Requirements:
Very good physical fitness and stamina

Previous experience in physically demanding, practical work

Ability to maintain a high and consistent working pace throughout the working day

Ability to work efficiently both independently and as part of a team

Reliability, punctuality and a strong work ethic

Willingness to work outdoors in different weather conditions

English language skills – you must be able to understand work instructions and make yourself understood in English

Valid Category B driving licence

Availability during BOTH employment periods in 2027

Additional Qualifications – Highly Valued
Category BE driving licence (car with heavy trailer) – a major advantage

Experience driving with trailers and operating machinery

Knowledge of Polish or Romanian

Previous experience in planting and landscaping

Please note: This is physically demanding work. We are looking for people who are accustomed to hard physical labour and can maintain a high working pace throughout a full working day.
What We Offer
Attractive salary and employment conditions

Employment covered by a Swedish collective bargaining agreement through Gröna arbetsgivare (the Swedish Green Employers' Organisation)

Salary in accordance with the applicable collective agreement, taking experience and qualifications into account

Full-time employment with opportunities for overtime

Assistance in arranging accommodation in Sweden at a favourable price

Company-paid hotel accommodation when overnight stays are required for work at other locations

Employment with an established Swedish company and experienced colleagues

Opportunities for returning seasonal employment

For suitable candidates, the possibility of continued, year-round employment

How to Apply
Please send us a short introduction about yourself, including:
Your name and previous work experience

Experience in physically demanding work

Your level of English

Your driving licence categories (B/BE)

Any knowledge of Polish or Romanian

Explicit confirmation that you are available for BOTH periods: 15 March – 30 June AND 15 August – 31 October 2027

Contact
Svedberga Plantskola AB
Email: info@svedberga.com
Phone: +46 10 188 80 00
Website: www.svedberga.com
You are also welcome to visit www.thujor.se to learn more about our business.
Email subject: Seasonal Employment 2027 – Sweden

jobs.employer_name: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Design Engineer Consultant – BEV Chassis Integration
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Location: Södertälje, Sweden
Duration: 2 years
Start Date: ASAP
Workload: 100%
Work Arrangement: On-site, 5 days per week
Language: English
Availability: Immediate availability required
Are you an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer with a background in heavy-duty vehicle development? Join Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB for a challenging two-year assignment focused on chassis integration for Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) solutions.
We are looking for a technically strong Design Engineer with previous R&D experience within a leading heavy-vehicle OEM environment and hands-on expertise in one or more of the following areas: sheet metal design, plastic components, pneumatic systems, and component installation.
About the Role
You will contribute to the mechanical design and integration of components and systems within BEV chassis platforms. Working closely with engineering teams, suppliers, and other stakeholders, you will develop practical design solutions that meet packaging, interface, installation, manufacturing, and functional requirements.
Experience in at least one of the specified technical areas is essential. Candidates with expertise across two or more areas will be particularly relevant.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop mechanical components and installation solutions for BEV chassis integration.
Work with sheet metal components, brackets, plastic components, and/or pneumatic installations.
Create and modify 3D models and 2D drawings using CATIA V5.
Manage component packaging, interfaces, tolerances, and installation requirements.
Ensure designs comply with applicable engineering standards and manufacturing requirements.
Collaborate with suppliers and cross-functional engineering teams throughout the development process.
Participate in design reviews, validation activities, and technical investigations.
Maintain accurate technical documentation and provide production support when required.
Contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the engineering team.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
Minimum 3 years of professional design engineering experience.
Mandatory: Previous R&D experience within a leading heavy-duty vehicle manufacturer or its group.
Strong hands-on competence in one or more of the following:
Sheet metal design, brackets, and installation solutions.
Plastic components and installation design.
Pneumatic components and installation systems.
Proficiency in CATIA V5, including 3D modelling and 2D drawing creation.
Experience with tolerance analysis.
Good understanding of component packaging, interfaces, and installation requirements.
Knowledge of design for manufacturability, particularly for sheet metal, plastic, and/or pneumatic components.
Good command of English.

Highly Valued Experience
Previous chassis design and integration experience within heavy-duty vehicles.
Experience working on BEV platforms and electrified vehicle architecture.
Expertise across multiple technical areas, such as sheet metal, plastics, and pneumatics.
Experience collaborating with suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Personal Attributes
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Proactive, self-motivated, and capable of independently driving design activities.
Practical and solution-oriented approach to engineering challenges.
Ability to coordinate effectively with suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders.
Willingness to share knowledge and contribute to team development.

Important Assignment Details
Duration: 2 years.
Start: ASAP – immediate availability required.
Location: Södertälje, Sweden.
Work Arrangement: Full-time, on-site, 5 days per week.
Language: English.

How to Apply
Are you ready to contribute to the next generation of electric heavy-duty vehicles?
Submit your updated CV through the Hykmann careers portal: https://www.hykmann.com/careers
Please highlight your previous heavy-vehicle OEM R&D experience, CATIA V5 expertise, relevant design competencies, availability, and earliest possible start date.

jobs.employer_name: SWEDEN RELOCATORS AB
jobs.description:
SWEDEN RELOCATORS AB is an immigration and relocation consultancy based in Malmö, established in 2015. We help individuals, families and companies from all over the world with residence permits, work permits and relocation to Sweden, through our online client portal and our office in Malmö. We are now looking for experienced Immigration Consultants to join our team.
About the role
As an Immigration Consultant you will handle immigration cases from start to finish and be the client's main point of contact throughout the process. You will work closely with our senior consultants and our relocation team.
Responsibilities:
Assess each client's situation and identify the right permit route
Prepare, quality check and submit complete applications to Migrationsverket (the Swedish Migration Agency), for example work permits, EU Blue Card, family reunification, EU right of residence, long-term residence and citizenship
Follow up on ongoing cases and respond to requests for supplementary information within the deadlines
Communicate with clients through our online portal, by email, by phone and in meetings
Draft cover letters and written statements, and support our senior team with reconsideration requests and appeals
Keep case files and documentation accurate and up to date
Coordinate with our relocation partners when a client also needs relocation services

Requirements:
You are based in Sweden and have the right to work in Sweden
At least 3 years of documented experience in immigration case handling, for example as an immigration consultant, case officer or paralegal
Fluent English, written and spoken
A structured and accurate way of working, and the ability to handle many cases at the same time while meeting deadlines
Good IT skills and experience of working with digital case management systems

Experience from your home country or another country:
If you have worked in this profession in your home country or elsewhere outside Sweden, this experience counts towards the requirement. Please attach a reference (name, title and contact details of your former manager) and a written confirmation from the employer, for example an employment certificate, that shows your position, period of employment and main duties. Documents in languages other than English or Swedish should be accompanied by an English translation. Experience that cannot be confirmed will not be taken into account.
Students are welcome to apply for part-time:
Are you studying and do you have experience in immigration case handling? You are welcome to apply for a part-time position that can be combined with your studies. State in your application that you are applying for part-time and how many hours per week you are available.
Desirable qualifications:
Experience of other immigration systems, for example Canada, Australia, New Zealand or the UK
Knowledge of Utlänningslagen (2005:716), EU free movement rules and Migrationsverket's procedures
Knowledge of Swedish
Post-secondary education in law, political science, social science or similar

We offer:
An important role in a growing company with clients from all over the world
A full-time position, or part-time for students
An introduction to our working methods and our digital client portal
A workplace at our office at Amiralsgatan 86E in Malmö

How to apply:
Send your CV, a short cover letter, your references and employment certificates to jobs@swedenrelocators.se. Mark your application "Immigration Consultant" or "Immigration Consultant, part-time". We review applications continuously, so please send yours as soon as possible.
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

Är du den speciallärare med bred ämnesbehörighet som kan inspirera våra elever på IES Norrtälje?

Trivs du i en internationell skolmiljö där du får möjlighet att utvecklas som både lärare och ledare? Då kan detta vara rollen för dig!

Vi söker en legitimerad speciallärare, med planerad start i januari 2027. 

Internationella Engelska Skolan i Norrtälje öppnade 2024 och har idag omkring 520 elever i årskurs F–9. 

Som medarbetare hos oss ingår du i ett arbetslag där ni tillsammans arbetar för att driva och utveckla verksamheten. Vi arbetar för att varje elev ska känna trygghet och trivsel i en lärande miljö. Vi arbetar för att väcka elevernas lust, engagemang, nyfikenhet och kreativitet. Varje elev ska få möjlighet att utvecklas utifrån sina förutsättningar och känna tilltro till sin egen förmåga. Undervisningen i svenska sker på svenska, medan engelska används frekvent i kommunikationen mellan personal.

It is important to point out to professional applicants that IESN is no ordinary Swedish school, quite the opposite - discipline and good manners are the constant order of the day and our conservative, but hugely challenging task, is to create and develop ladies and gentlemen of the future.

The school is bilingual which means we utilise both English and Swedish in our class instruction and we endeavour to develop

students who quickly learn to line-up quietly and pay attention to the language that they implement.

Furthermore, we do not believe in 'lagom' and we encourage competition and winning.

In addition, IESN can only employ teachers with Swedish teaching accreditation ie. Lärarlegitimationen, but we are always open to applications which show initiative or the recognition that teaching is not a job but a 'calling', wherein going the extra mile is a given necessity to achieve the best for students.

Should you wish to pursue your interest in IESN further, then please do send us your individual CV's and Cover letters in English.Det här erbjuder vi

- En internationell och inspirerande arbetsplats där svenska och engelska används parallellt.

- En skola med studiero, tydliga rutiner och en positiv kultur som gynnar både elever och personal.

Fluent English communication skills; Swedish is an advantage.
Strong organisational, administrative, and documentation skills.

Training or personal certifications related to PED, ASME, AWS, or similar standards.
Basic understanding of mechanical and electrical engineering equipment.
Experience with SAP or PLM2020.
Knowledge of additional languages besides English.
